description: This file defines a controller class 'GeolocApiController' for a web API that provides geolocation services based on IP addresses and location data management. It interacts with external geolocation databases and internal location models, handling requests related to retrieving and updating location information.

classes.name: GeolocApiController
classes.description: Controller class providing API endpoints for geolocation data retrieval and location management, including actions for IP-based geolocation and user location updates.

methods.name: geolocationAction
methods.description: Handles requests to obtain geolocation data based on IP address, utilizing MaxMind database, and returns location details in JSON format.

methods.name: geolocateAction
methods.description: Handles requests to retrieve or update location data for a user or specified entity, supporting both GET and POST methods, with permission checks.
